title: ChangeEventMessage
description: The structure of a Change Data Capture event message as received by subscribers. Contains the event header with change metadata and the changed field values.

ChangeEventHeader.description: Header containing metadata about the change

entityName.description: The SObject type that changed (e.g., Account)

recordIds.description: Array of record IDs that changed (may be batched)

changeType.description: The type of change. GAP_ prefixed types indicate events replayed after a gap in delivery.

changeOrigin.description: The origin of the change (e.g., com/salesforce/api/rest/63.0)

transactionKey.description: Unique key identifying the transaction that caused the change

sequenceNumber.description: Sequence number for ordering within a transaction

commitTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the change was committed

commitUser.description: The 18-character ID of the user who made the change

changedFields.description: List of field API names that changed (for UPDATE events)

nulledFields.description: List of field API names that were set to null

diffFields.description: List of fields included in the change event payload
